summary: The change exempts exact loopback hostnames from the plaintext rejection while retaining the 426 response for non-loopback HTTP, and adds regression coverage for both paths. No actionable defect was found in the committed change.

evidence: main.ts lines 4-10 exempt localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] from the HTTP 426 guard while non-loopback plaintext still returns 426.
src/main_test.ts covers allowed loopback HTTP hosts, uppercase localhost, non-loopback HTTP rejection, forwarded-host spoof attempts, and direct or proxy-terminated HTTPS.
src/handler_test.ts imports main_test.ts so the added regression tests run within the existing deno task test file list.
